result.question: What happens to Uzziah when he seeks Yahweh?

assessments.reason: Directly matches v.5: “as long as he sought the LORD, God gave him success,” which is equivalent to “made him prosper.”
v.7 states “God helped him,” which describes what happened in that period; while v.5 ties seeking specifically to success/prospering, divine help is a reasonable paraphrase of the favorable outcome.
